name: Capture & Route
tagline: Turn messy inputs into a structured idea system.
for_whom: Anyone with too many inputs and not enough structure — thinkers, builders, parents, operators.
outcome: Every input lands in the right place. Tasks go to your task manager. Ideas to your knowledge base. Completions to your daily log. Nothing dropped, nothing lost.
user_journey: Throw items at Virgil through any channel during the day (TUI, Telegram, scratchpad)
Virgil labels each item and routes it: tasks to your task manager, ideas to your archive, completions to your daily log
At end of day, /wrap-up closes out and posts a recap
At end of cycle, V (items successfully put through) is reported

primary.name: V
primary.description: items successfully put through per cycle

dependencies.task_manager: Required — Notion (default) or any task manager with an API
